discription: A clean bell-like tone using two detuned sine waves with a short, percussive envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.005; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.001, 0.3, 0.0, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) + SinOsc.ar(freq * detune)) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
